title: TaskSpec
description: A bounded unit of implementation work targeting one or more acceptance criteria, used as a graph-engine.mjs execution-graph node. Consumer: ops.mjs task open/close. Also doubles as a capability-mobilization record (lib/capability-ledger.mjs) when `assignedAgent` names a registry agent/skill and `criterionIds` is empty -- the extra statuses below (PLANNED/DISPATCHED/RUNNING/COMPLETED/NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_EVIDENCE/FAILED) exist for that use only; PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/DONE/BLOCKED remain the original implementation-task vocabulary and are unaffected.

notApplicableReason.description: Required (non-empty) when status is NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_EVIDENCE -- must state the concrete technical reason, not a vague dismissal. Enforced by lib/capability-ledger.mjs, not the schema alone.
